Calculate the number-average molecular weight Mn using the formula Mn = Σ(Ni × Mi) / Σ(Ni).
The four fractions are: Mi = 56526 g/mol with Ni = 96; Mi = 92809 g/mol with Ni = 131; Mi = 115856 g/mol with Ni = 153; Mi = 126029 g/mol with Ni = 146.
Compute the numerator: (96 × 56526) + (131 × 92809) + (153 × 115856) + (146 × 126029) = 5,426,496 + 12,157,979 + 17,725,968 + 18,400,234 = 53,710,677.
Compute the denominator: 96 + 131 + 153 + 146 = 526.
Divide: Mn = 53,710,677 / 526 ≈ 102,112 g/mol.
Report the final answer as Mn ≈ 102,112 g/mol.
